summary: SkinVision is a health technology company focused on increasing access to skin health awareness and care. It supports individuals in becoming more aware of their skin over time, helping them take a more active role in their health journey. The service is currently not available in the United States, pending regulatory clearance.
medicalPurpose: To increase access to skin health awareness and care, and to support individuals in becoming more aware of their skin over time.
roleInDecisionMaking: To help individuals take a more active role in their skin health journey by increasing awareness and accessibility to information.
intendedUsers: Individuals seeking to increase their awareness and understanding of their skin health.
targetPatientPopulation: The target patient population includes individuals and people seeking to increase their skin health awareness and care, become more aware of their skin over time, and take a more active role in their health journey.
knownPerformanceLimitations: SkinVision is not yet available in the United States; U.S. availability is subject to FDA authorization and U.S. launch is planned pending applicable regulatory clearance.

modelDevelopmentAndValidation.description: The company collaborates with medical experts, researchers, and leading institutions, including Mayo Clinic, for ongoing research and development in digital health.
